name: Diagnosis Of Hiv/Aids
overview: Diagnosis Of Hiv/Aids is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include hiv tests are used to detect the presence of the human immunodeficiency virus (hiv), the virus that can lead to aids, in serum, saliva, or urine; such tests may detect antibodies, antigens, or rna. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
